entries.subject: Radius adopted from the published record
entries.finding: Radius: Limb-darkened angular diameter 5.999 ± 0.025 mas measured with VLTI/PIONIER by Kervella et al. (2017), A&A 597, A137, who derive 0.8632 ± 0.0037 solar radii with the parallax 747.17 ± 0.61 mas. Adopted 600,528 km, 0.8632 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is adopted. Placement: SIMBAD basic record for * alf Cen B (HIP 71681), ICRS J2000 position, reference 2007A&A...474..653V, retrieved 2026-09-21: https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=alf+Cen+B; Inverse of the parallax 747.17 ± 0.61 mas that Kervella et al. (2017) adopt from Kervella et al. (2016).
